name: Sonselasuchus
sum: Sonselasuchus is a shuvosaurid poposauroid from the Late Triassic Chinle Formation of Arizona, known from a bone bed of at least 36 individuals.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: A specimen from the Petrified Forest National Park bone bed (the Commons image title cites PEFO); catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: A bone bed of at least 36 individuals representing the whole skeleton - skull bones, vertebrae, forelimb, pectoral, hind limb and pelvic elements.
biology: The sources consulted describe the bone bed and osteology but give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Armour Smith and Sidor 2026

sources.text: E. Armour Smith and C. A. Sidor. 2026. Osteology and relationships of a new shuvosaurid (Pseudosuchia, Poposauroidea) from the Upper Triassic Chinle Formation of Petrified Forest National Park, Arizona, U.S.A. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology
